name: Decaf coffee
description: Coffee with the caffeine stripped out — around 97% of it, not all.

tcm.note: Read with coffee; the nature is not in the caffeine.

histamine.note: Still a liberator — that mechanism is not caffeine, which is why decaf disappoints people who switched for it.

stimulant.note: Caffeine mostly removed. What remains is the liberator effect, which was never caffeine's doing.
